scope: Add exact-head source-free ordinary and independently reviewed callback Fin acceptance jobs to three already registered recurring workflows. Preserve every checked-record job and trigger, retain complete reports on failure, and repair only the two current inventory pins that cite changed workflow bytes. This source transition does not promote any Fin cell; installed claims require authenticated hosted artifacts and independent replay.

edits.current:
callback-fin-languages:
    name: Checked Fin callbacks in three installed language packages
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision and original evidence history
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
      - name: Select Python 3.12
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Select Ruby 3.3
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.3.12'
      - name: Bound apt network waits
        uses: ./.github/actions/bounded-apt
        timeout-minutes: 1
      - name: Install compiler and archive dependencies
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake curl git jq libgmp-dev libuv1-dev m4 pkg-config ripgrep xz-utils zstd
      - name: Install dependencies and pinned Lean and Rust compilers
        timeout-minutes: 30
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          mkdir -p build
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only 2>&1 | tee build/callback-fin-languages-toolchain.log
          bash scripts/bootstrap-rust-ci.sh 2>&1 | tee -a build/callback-fin-languages-toolchain.log
      - name: Require both author routes in all three languages
        id: acceptance
        timeout-minutes: 150
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source scripts/env.sh
          python_command=$(command -v python)
          ruby_command=$(command -v ruby)
          gem_command=$(command -v gem)
          bash scripts/run-callback-fin-languages-ci.sh \
            "$python_command" "$ruby_command" "$gem_command" \
            "$PWD/.toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/rustc" \
            "$PWD/.toolchains/rust-1.90.0/bin/cargo"
      - name: Preserve original and partial installed records
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: callback-fin-languages-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/callback-fin-languages-ci/
            build/callback-fin-languages-toolchain.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce installed callback Fin language acceptance
        if: always() && steps.acceptance.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

callback-fin-perl:
    name: Checked Fin callbacks on all four Perl ABIs
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision and original evidence history
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
      - name: Install the checkout dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Bound apt network waits
        uses: ./.github/actions/bounded-apt
        timeout-minutes: 1
      - name: Install the native build tools
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y build-essential curl zstd
      - name: Install only the pinned Lean compiler
        run: bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only
      - name: Restore the complete checksummed Perl toolchain matrix
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .toolchains/perl
          key: perl-callback-fin-abi-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('scripts/build-perl-toolchains.mjs') }}
      - name: Build or verify every pinned Perl interpreter
        run: |
          node scripts/build-perl-toolchains.mjs 5.36.3 threaded
          node scripts/build-perl-toolchains.mjs 5.36.3 unthreaded
          node scripts/build-perl-toolchains.mjs 5.38.2 threaded
          node scripts/build-perl-toolchains.mjs 5.38.2 unthreaded
      - name: Require author routes and install modes
        id: acceptance
        timeout-minutes: 150
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source scripts/env.sh
          bash scripts/run-callback-fin-perl-ci.sh
      - name: Preserve original and partial installed records
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: callback-fin-perl-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/callback-fin-perl-ci/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce installed Perl callback Fin acceptance
        if: always() && steps.acceptance.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1

callback-fin-remaining:
    name: Checked Fin callbacks in ${{ matrix.lane }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 180
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [dotnet, jvm, php-native, wit-wasi]
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision and original evidence history
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: "22"
          cache: npm
      - name: Select .NET 8
        if: matrix.lane == 'dotnet'
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        env:
          DOTNET_INSTALL_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/lean-bridge-callback-fin-dotnet
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.424'
      - name: Select Java 22
        if: matrix.lane == 'jvm'
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '22.0.2'
      - name: Install the checksummed Kotlin 2.2 compiler
        if: matrix.lane == 'jvm'
        timeout-minutes: 10
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build
          curl -fL --retry 3 --output build/kotlin-compiler.zip https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin/releases/download/v2.2.0/kotlin-compiler-2.2.0.zip
          echo '1adb6f1a5845ba0aa5a59e412e44c8e405236b957de1a9683619f1dca3b16932  build/kotlin-compiler.zip' | sha256sum --check
          unzip -q build/kotlin-compiler.zip -d build/kotlin-tools
      - name: Bound apt network waits
        uses: ./.github/actions/bounded-apt
        timeout-minutes: 1
      - name: Install compiler, package and archive dependencies
        timeout-minutes: 20
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          packages=(build-essential cmake curl git jq libgmp-dev libuv1-dev m4 pkg-config ripgrep unzip xz-utils zstd)
          if [[ '${{ matrix.lane }}' == jvm ]]; then packages+=(maven); fi
          if [[ '${{ matrix.lane }}' == php-native ]]; then
            packages+=(composer php-cli php-common php-dev php-mbstring php-zip)
          fi
          sudo apt-get install -y "${packages[@]}"
      - name: Install dependencies and the pinned Lean compiler
        timeout-minutes: 30
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
          mkdir -p build
          bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --lean-only 2>&1 | tee build/callback-fin-remaining-${{ matrix.lane }}-toolchain.log
          if [[ '${{ matrix.lane }}' == wit-wasi ]]; then
            bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --wasm-tools-only 2>&1 | tee -a build/callback-fin-remaining-${{ matrix.lane }}-toolchain.log
          fi
      - name: Build the pinned Wasmtime C API
        if: matrix.lane == 'wit-wasi'
        timeout-minutes: 30
        shell: bash
        run: |
          (
            set -euo pipefail
            test "$(uname -sm)" = 'Linux x86_64'
            mkdir -p build
            test ! -e build/wasmtime-c-api && test ! -L build/wasmtime-c-api
            WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING=$(mktemp -d build/wasmtime-c-api.XXXXXX)
            trap 'rm -rf -- "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING"' EXIT
            curl --fail --location --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 300 \
              --output "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/wasmtime.tar.xz" \
              'https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/releases/download/v42.0.1/wasmtime-v42.0.1-x86_64-linux-c-api.tar.xz'
            echo '2097a47351918a446b26c7e65f487278f63bc947591b71897db547cd90c05082  '"$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/wasmtime.tar.xz" | sha256sum --check --status
            mkdir "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked"
            tar -xJf "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/wasmtime.tar.xz" --strip-components=1 -C "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/include/wasmtime.h"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/include/wasm.h"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/lib/libwasmtime.so"
            test -s "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked/lib/libwasmtime.a"
            mv -T "$WASMTIME_CAPI_STAGING/unpacked" build/wasmtime-c-api
          )
      - name: Require both author routes
        id: acceptance
        timeout-minutes: 150
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          source scripts/env.sh
          case '${{ matrix.lane }}' in
            dotnet)
              bash scripts/run-callback-fin-remaining-ci.sh dotnet \
                "$RUNNER_TEMP/lean-bridge-callback-fin-dotnet/dotnet"
              ;;
            jvm)
              bash scripts/run-callback-fin-remaining-ci.sh jvm \
                "$JAVA_HOME/bin/java" "$JAVA_HOME/bin/javac" \
                "$PWD/build/kotlin-tools/kotlinc/bin/kotlinc" "$(command -v mvn)"
              ;;
            php-native)
              bash scripts/run-callback-fin-remaining-ci.sh php-native \
                "$(command -v php)" "$(command -v composer)"
              ;;
            wit-wasi)
              bash scripts/run-callback-fin-remaining-ci.sh wit-wasi \
                "/usr/bin/cc" "$PWD/.toolchains/wasm-tools/bin/wasm-tools" \
                "$PWD/build/wasmtime-c-api"
              ;;
          esac
      - name: Preserve original and partial installed records
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: callback-fin-remaining-${{ matrix.lane }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            build/callback-fin-remaining-ci-${{ matrix.lane }}/
            build/callback-fin-remaining-${{ matrix.lane }}-toolchain.log
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Enforce installed callback Fin acceptance
        if: always() && steps.acceptance.outcome != 'success'
        run: exit 1
